hooks.name: Protect data provenance
hooks.description: This is a public repository: only public or fully synthetic data may be committed; weights, field volumes and copyright application material must stay out.

action.prompt: A file under data/ or doc/ was just saved. Enforce the data policy for this public hackathon repo: no proprietary/licensed field data, no model weights, no large .npy/.sgy/.pt volumes, and no software-copyright application material from doc/. Confirm the artefact is gitignored, and point to scripts/generate_synthetic_seismic.py as the reproducible way to create demo data. Never present UAV hardware or quantum sensing as implemented.

hooks.name: Check provenance document
hooks.description: Whenever the data provenance note changes, verify no forbidden binary artefacts are tracked by git.
